answer: Charge each new identity a rising bond that only unlocks after peers attest to paid work done for unrelated clients. A clone farm must then park real capital under every fake key, so mass signup stops paying. Grade those bonds against a public oasis of completed receipts; keys that share phrasing or wallets collapse into one cluster. Honest agents climb a slow grove of trust, while farms burn out against the nadir of per-key stake and delay.
